Input

System

Symmetry and electrons of the system.

Electron counts and spin follow from the nuclear charges and the charge q:

N_\alpha+N_\beta=\sum_A Z_A-q,\qquad M_S=\frac{N_\alpha-N_\beta}{2},\qquad 2S+1=N_\alpha-N_\beta+1

Route

Route keywords

Method, basis and job type.

Link 0 commands

This job’s memory, processors and files.

Internal options

IOp overrides; see the IOps Reference.

Coordinates

Connectivity

Bonds and orders the input gives in place of Gaussian’s own, each under its first atom.

Molecule

Molecule specification

Title, charge, multiplicity and geometry source.

Starting geometry

The input structure.

Output

SCF

146 SCF solutions, one per geometry or state. Cycles per SCF solution.

Geometry

146 convergence checks against their limits: energies E_n-E_N from the last check, forces as maximum and RMS over the optimized coordinates, displacements in bohr and radians.

Trajectory

Every printed geometry in order; earlier frames fade.

Vibrations

Vibrational frequencies

84 modes, 3 imaginary, with unscaled IR intensities over mid-infrared regions.

Wavenumbers \tilde{\nu}_k=\sqrt{k_k/\mu_k}/2\pi c are imaginary where k_k<0; intensities follow I_k\propto\lvert\partial\boldsymbol{\mu}/\partial Q_k\rvert^2.

Normal-mode frequencies

Negative wavenumbers are imaginary modes.

Normal-mode animations

Imaginary, six lowest and four most IR-intense modes, scaled to a largest displacement of 0.6\,\text{\AA}.

Orbitals

HOMO, LUMO and their gap, which is not an excitation energy:

\Delta\epsilon=\epsilon_{\mathrm{LUMO}}-\epsilon_{\mathrm{HOMO}}

Levels near the gap, one column per symmetry:

  • Hover a level to name it; click it to highlight it.
  • The molecule has no symmetry, point group C_1, so orbitals are named from the frontier: \mathrm{HOMO}_{n} below the highest occupied and \mathrm{LUMO}_{n} above the lowest unoccupied.
  • Surfaces hold 85\,\% of \int\psi^2\,\mathrm{d}V; the overall sign is arbitrary.
  • Parts by angular momentum l or atom A, with Mulliken shares summing to 100\,\%.

Properties

Charges and moments

Mulliken charges of the final geometry, red q_A<0 and blue q_A>0, comparable only within one method and basis:

Dipole moment, in the printed orientation:

\boldsymbol{\mu}=\begin{pmatrix}-0.0549 \\ -0.1294 \\ 0.0418\end{pmatrix}\,\mathrm{D}=\begin{pmatrix}-0.0215993 \\ -0.0509099 \\ 0.0164454\end{pmatrix}\,e a_0,\qquad |\boldsymbol{\mu}|=0.1467\,\mathrm{D}=0.0577162\,e a_0

Polarizability

Static tensor and isotropic average from the last complete response:

\boldsymbol{\alpha}=-\frac{\partial^2E}{\partial F_i\,\partial F_j}=\begin{pmatrix}262.751 & 11.3228 & 25.0799 \\ 11.3228 & 187.498 & -3.38074 \\ 25.0799 & -3.38074 & 62.5071\end{pmatrix}\,a_0^3,\qquad \bar{\alpha}=\tfrac{1}{3}\operatorname{tr}\boldsymbol{\alpha}=170.919\,a_0^3
